payload.title: Story pace of gummy worms in zero gravity
payload.body: Aboard the spaceship Sugar Comet, twenty fictional groups of gummy worms told the same tale of a marshmallow moon, half with gravity switched on and half floating. Groups with gravity finished in an average of 60 seconds; floating groups finished in 45 seconds. Floating storytellers paused less because nobody had to climb back onto the story rug. The study measured pace only; it did not test what listeners remembered. All results are invented demonstration data. Correction: a timing error had shortened the floating average, which is 45 seconds, not 40.
